instruction: Read all current sources, incorporating the three explicitly reviewer-prepared transcriptions of the official manufacturer brochures. Keep their source IDs and exact locators/quotes; the transcriptions are not new manufacturer publications. Selected comparison configurations are Nexon Fearless + PS 1.2L turbo petrol seven-speed DCA, Brezza ZXi+ 1.5L K15C petrol ISG six-speed automatic, and regular Venue HX10 Kappa 1.0L Turbo GDi petrol seven-speed DCT. They are comparison examples, not a statement that the current buyer has selected a variant. Preserve every fuel, engine, transmission, trim, date, market, price-basis and offer qualification in each fact. Extract front-seat ventilation, rear AC vents, standard ISOFIX, the warranty headline, the selected automatic pairing, front sensors and rear-seat flexibility from their supplied evidence. Do not infer luggage/child-seat fit, flood or water capability, smoothness, economy, warranty exclusions or whichever-comes-first terms. Ordinary specifications are stated, not certified. Do not blend brochure kW values with differently expressed website figures or borrow RPM from another source. Keep rivals separate from product facts, and use the qualified source for the requested trim. Camera/BVM begins at Creative in the product brochure; front sensors are a separate Creative + PS/Fearless + PS fact. Keep the exact introductory finance amount and all stated conditions together, and distinguish starting ex-showroom pricing from a local quote. Extract only information actually supplied. Previous reviewed records are context, not authority for a different source or ID. Include remaining unanswered buyer questions without contradicting readable warranty, ventilation or ISOFIX evidence.
